PropertySetDef.Name: Pset_FurnitureElementCommon

PropertyDef.Name: IsUsed
PropertyDef.Definition: indicates whether the element is being used in a workstation or not.

PropertyDef.Name: Width
PropertyDef.Definition: I.e. nominal width. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

PropertyDef.Name: Height
PropertyDef.Definition: I.e. nominal length. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.
